|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “While present at a battleground site, once during each of your opponent's turns, you may look through opponent's Lost Pile and 'steal' one droid, starfighter, vehicle, weapon, or device card there into your hand to use as your own.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Reegesk (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “During opponent’s turn, if present at a battleground site, may steal a device, droid, starfighter, vehicle, or weapon in opponent’s Lost Pile into your hand.” '''What changed:''' “While” → “During opponent’s turn, if”; removed “once during each of your opponent's turns, you”; “look through opponent's Lost Pile and 'steal' one” → “steal a device,”; removed “weapon,”; “device card there” → “weapon in opponent’s Lost Pile”; “hand to use as your own.” → “hand.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 44. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Reegesk]].
* Later text: [[Reegesk (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
